additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472930-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Log check on charger CRM:00263000370
additional_info.body:
Dear Manuela,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0472930
, as this ticket was handed over to me.
I also made some research on both chargers in the morning of 17.01.2026, but I couldn't find any charging session around the timestamp provided (11:28 CET).
Could you please let me know when the customer reported the problem, with a precise timestamp in time and date?
From my side, I can look in general for charging sessions, but without a feedback from the customer I would not be able to tell if the one I am analysing are the correct ones or not.
If no timestamp can be provided, we will proceed to close the ticket and you can open it again if the customer will give more details.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472930-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Log check on charger CRM:00263000370
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Thank you for the feedback. We only know that the customer tried to charge on the 17
th
of January between 9:15 a.m. and 9:40 a.m. (CU Time), and he said that 3 pre-authorizations were blocked.
We do not see any recharge in that time. At this point, it is possible that the customer connected the plug without beginning recharge, and the pre-authorization blocked were not related to IPlanet.
The ticket can be closed.
Thank you and Regards,
Filomena
